title: Steerable Pluralism: Pluralistic Alignment via Few-Shot Comparative Regression

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the default response selections of unaligned LLMs and standard reward models to demonstrate their inherent implicit bias towards 'high' target attributes (e.g., high moral values like care and fairness, or high preference values like helpfulness and verbosity), rather than aligning with diverse, pluralistic user profiles.
